Episode 248. Welcome to Laprarosa (2)
People had an intuition.
That if the person on the balcony above decided to act, more than 90% of the crowd gathered here would lose their lives within ten seconds.
It was a realm that everyone could instinctively understand – not just the uninhabited or the non-uninhabited, but even young children holding their parents' hands.
The sense of reality was fading.
The fact that a person with such vast power could exist was incomprehensible, even when seen with one's own eyes.
A giant who far surpassed common sense, categories, and standards.

The crowd had never seen such a person before. Even those who had experienced the tyranny of the Evil God and the destructive power of the Demon Realm and the Red Plutonian, this being was incomparably powerful.
Normally, they would have trembled in fear.
No, they would have been frozen stiff, unable to tremble, unable to open their eyes or breathe, slowly suffocating. Just facing her would have made it so, if she wanted.
But now it was the opposite.
The crowd was gaining infinite faith from her. As long as she existed, it seemed like the world would never again be engulfed in a pit of fire.
Because Ban was clearly one of Jin's people. The brothers Jin had been freed at the risk of his life.

"I, half a millennium ago, wanted to raise this place, Laprarosa, to the highest place in the sky. To exterminate all those called gods with the power of the Plutonians alone, and prove that the most powerful and radiant beings in this world were our Plutonians."

Ban paused, recalling the faint but unforgettable memories of that day. It seemed like the passionate hearts of the brothers who couldn't be saved, who didn't survive to see the world again, were flickering.
"It was foolish. Now, I don't remember clearly why we tried to kill them, why we had such feelings. But the reason we had to lose then is clear."
It was because we only thought of ourselves.
A confession and repentance, half a millennium in the making, were knocking on Laprarosa.

"We only thought of ourselves. There wasn't a complete lack of justification, but fundamentally, we fought for ourselves. We tried to prove our power, and the way to do it was to conquer the world. Doesn't it sound familiar? Shamefully, we were not much different from the enemies Jin's brothers have been defeating until now."
The Plutonians members among the crowd lowered their heads. Ban continued in a calm voice.
"On the other hand, Jin's brother has always fought a different battle. Jin's brother always tried to protect the weak, take responsibility, and save lives. That eventually opened a new path for us."
Jin was regretting.
'To think the Battle God Brother would suddenly burden me with such a responsibility. I should have asked her what she was going to say and stopped her...'
Certainly, after his return, Jin had achieved many great feats. The world considered him a guardian and trusted and relied on him.
But Jin always thought. The great tragedies that disturb the world now didn't exist before his return.
Guilt, debt, and responsibility. Jin thought he was doing what he naturally should as a returner.

- The deaths that lie on your path are not your responsibility. They are the responsibility of the being that made you that way. But when you reach the end of that path... maybe you won't be crushed by so many deaths. There must be a reason you obtained the power of regeneration as soon as you became Genesis.
- So don't fall under the weight of guilt, Jin. You must not fall, for those who have died, those who will die, to give them back their lives.
Ji
n suddenly remembered what Ayulra had said before she vanished. The words of encouragement left by the God of Hope echoed within him, comforting him.
"From now on, our Plutonians want to follow that path. To protect the weak, take responsibility, and save lives."
The eyes of the crowd were shining. They couldn't applaud or cheer, but emotion seemed to pour out of their eyes, welling up from their hearts.

"You must believe in me. Maybe with me and my brothers alone, the world will never be in danger again. But that's a mistaken thought. Always, the power of one person, the power of one group alone, cannot do everything. It's a lesson already proven half a millennium ago. Therefore, you must also fight."
Ban slowly looked around at the people gathered below.

"It means to endure each of your lives, and thus always fiercely proclaim your existence in this world. The power of a single exceptional individual, capable of bringing down a mountain in one strike, can be easily erased. But erasing the lives of numerous people without a trace is a difficult task."
Ban wasn't just offering hollow words of comfort for the powerless.
She was speaking about a very realistic matter, something that could counteract Ziffle's manipulation of history.

"A thousand years ago, I taught the first head of the Runkandel clan, and even then Ziffle had been manipulating history as they pleased. They erased what they wanted and people forgot. However, what they erased from the world were just a few events and records. Even Zifel at their peak a thousand years ago couldn't erase everyone's lives."
The power of existence.
A thousand years ago, Runkandel resisted Ziffle's historical manipulation based on Temar's power of existence.
To Ban, the power of existence was a kind of focal point. No matter how great the power of existence one person had, it was useless without people gathering around it.
Like the people who followed Temar, believed in him, and relied on him.
Now, the Barmel Alliance had to stand against history manipulation, centered around Jin.

"If we are erased, you must remember and find us, and if you are erased, we will remember and find you. We can't win against the dark shadow of history manipulation unless we unite. But if we do unite, we will surely win."
People were nodding their heads.

And now, instead of looking at Ban, they were looking at Jin. Just as they had felt an indescribably overwhelming force when Ban first appeared, they were now seeing 'the power of existence' from Jin.

"Of course, the best thing would be to end them before Ziffle completes their history manipulation. In reality, their ability to manipulate history is not yet seriously threatening. The same goes for Kinzelo, the Sun God Religion, or Ganesto. It's better to end it before the enemies achieve what they want. Now, the military power of the Barmel Alliance is overwhelming, so it's entirely possible."
In terms of military power, no force could now dare to follow the Barmel Alliance. Even if the Red Plutonian or the Demon Realm, who were destroyed a week ago, suddenly returned.
"So now is the moment I introduce you to the Plutonian brothers and give our last warning to our enemies as the leader of the Barmel Alliance"
Millions had gathered. Humans, beastmen, demons, dragons, and various other species living in the Human World were present in Laprarosa.
Among them, there would undoubtedly be enemies mixed in. It was impossible that there weren't enemies hiding among the crowd, spying on Laprarosa.
The Alliance didn't even attempt to stop such espionage. Instead, they hoped that they would see everything correctly and return.

How much the Plutonians  had revived, whether Luna had become Genesis after defeating Shimat, and how strong the current Barmel Alliance was. They wanted them to clearly understand with their own eyes.

They didn't even consider a mass murder attack. If any of the scouts tried such a thing, they would inevitably be caught before it happened. It was impossible to carry out a successful terror attack, bypassing the senses of Ban, Jin, Luna, Murakan, and other superhumans of the Alliance.

Above all, if civilians attending the festival were harmed at this time, the Alliance could immediately lead all their forces and attack every power. There would be nothing more burdensome for the enemies. It had been less than ten days since the great Red Plutonians were destroyed overnight.
"I will give you a week."
Murderous intent appeared in Jin's eyes. Eyes that were utterly beautiful to those who believed in him, and absolute terror to his enemies.
"Kinzelo, the Sun God Religion, surrender within a week. Then, I promise you minimal dignified treatment and proper legal procedures."
Of course, even if the enemies surrendered, he had no intention of sparing them from punishment.

"If you don't surrender within a week, you will experience terrible things. You will crumble at an unimaginable speed and never be able to rise again. Surrendering is the most dignified end you can choose."
Kinzelo, the Sun God Religion. Jin only advised these two forces to surrender.
Because he couldn't afford to show mercy to Ziffle and Ganesto.

"Ziffle, Runkandel's thousand-year-old enemy, and Ganesto, the trashy group of betrayers, just stay as you are. It's finally time to annihilate you... However, those at the bottom and employees who have been used and discarded like disposable goods can seek mercy from the Barmel Alliance. If their crimes aren't too filthy, after investigation and punishment, we will allow them to live not as dogs, but as humans."
There was a moment of silence. It felt like the Alliance members could hear the spies hidden in the crowd swallowing hard.
Then Jin smiled gently at the crowd.
"That's the end of the speech prepared by me and brother Ban. Now, everyone who has come, please fully enjoy Laprarosa and return home."
